health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.description: A vial of crimson liquid that restores vitality when consumed.

scroll_of_lightning.name: Scroll of Lightning
scroll_of_lightning.description: A crackling scroll that strikes the nearest enemy with a bolt of lightning.

potion_haste.name: Potion of Haste
potion_haste.description: A potion that greatly increases your speed for a short duration.

scroll_confusion.name: Scroll of Confusion
scroll_confusion.description: A scroll covered in erratic runes. Confuses the nearest enemy.

scroll_fireball.name: Scroll of Fireball
scroll_fireball.description: Unleashes a massive fireball that damages all enemies in a wide radius.

scroll_identify.name: Scroll of Identify
scroll_identify.description: Magical script that reveals the true nature of all items in your inventory.

food_ration.name: Food Ration
food_ration.description: A wrapped bundle of dried meats and bread. Highly nutritious.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: A crisp, red apple. Good for a quick snack.

leather_armor.name: Leather Armor
leather_armor.description: Tanned hide stitched into a vest. Provides modest protection.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: A sturdy pack that increases the amount of items you can carry.

venom_dagger.name: Venom Dagger
venom_dagger.description: A wicked blade dripping with corrosive poison.

rock.name: Heavy Rock
rock.description: A heavy, jagged rock. Good for throwing.

potion_of_fire.name: Flask of Alchemist's Fire
potion_of_fire.description: A volatile mixture that explodes on impact.

lockpick.name: Lockpick
lockpick.description: A set of tools for picking locks.

wand_of_lightning.name: Wand of Lightning
wand_of_lightning.description: A wand that shoots a beam of lightning, piercing through enemies.

wand_of_fire.name: Wand of Fire
wand_of_fire.description: A wand that shoots a bolt of fire, stopping at the first enemy hit.

wand_of_cold.name: Wand of Cold
wand_of_cold.description: A wand that emits a cone of freezing cold air.

camp_sigil.name: Camp Sigil
camp_sigil.description: The stolen crest of the Safe Hub. Bringing it back will secure the camp.

barkeeper_note.name: Barkeeper's Bloody Note
barkeeper_note.description: A bloody note written by the barkeeper before his death. It says: 'The Bandit King has the Camp Sigil in his chest. Defeat him and take the sigil!'

scholar_journal.name: Scholar's Lost Journal
scholar_journal.description: The scholar's journal. It contains notes about the Shrine Vault: 'Sacrifice monster remains (bones) at the altar to receive the gods' blessing!'

bones.name: Monster Remains
bones.description: Remains of a defeated feral monster. Can be placed on the altar.
